facts.fact: ITU technical assistance project 9UGA21008 (CHF 1,651,100, about US$1.82m, January 2021 to December 2023, status completed) supported Uganda's Ministry of ICT and National Guidance and NITA-U in formulating a 'National ICT Development Strategy'; the document does not say the strategy was adopted, and gives no date of its own so the published year 2021 is used.

ITU committed CHF 1,651,100 (US$1,816,210 estimated) to the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance and NITA-U for strategy formulation and capacity building over 2021-2023; no domestic budget line is stated; date is the published year 2021.
